verified.note: Light-grey letters with a faint fine dotted rim of mid-grey dots.

cards.name: 40%Grey 2pt No Fill
cards.id: Required/Legacy Styles and More.asl#40%Grey 2pt No Fill
cards.path: Required/Legacy Styles and More.asl/Legacy Styles and More/All Legacy Default Styles/Dotted Strokes
cards.summary: Almost invisible hollow outline: fill opacity 0% plus a 2 px inside Stroke of mid-grey dots ('2pt 40% Grey', about 155 on the 128 ground, measured). On the grey test ground the letters nearly vanish; it needs a lighter or darker background to read. Effects stored in the style: Stroke.
use_for: ghost watermark lettering on a light ground
avoid: mid-grey and dark backgrounds: practically invisible
small text: dots break up
anywhere legibility matters
cards.applies_to: a text, shape or pixel layer (not the locked Background layer: double-click it to unlock first). The effects follow the layer's transparency edge, so it reads best on bold type or a solid shape. Effect sizes are in pixels: on a much larger or smaller document use Layer > Layer Style > Scale Effects. The style also sets the layer's Fill Opacity to 0% (decoded from the file): the layer's own fill is faded accordingly and the effects carry the look.

cards.name: 40%Grey 3pt Filled
cards.path: Required/Legacy Styles and More.asl/Legacy Styles and More/All Legacy Default Styles/Dotted Strokes
cards.summary: Keeps the letter fill and adds a 3 px dotted rim from the '3pt 40% Grey' pattern; coarser dots than the 2pt version and fainter than the 20% version (mid-grey dots, about 155 on a 128 ground, measured). It adds no colour of its own: the letters keep the layer's own fill (light grey in the thumbnail). Effects stored in the style: Stroke.
use_for: quiet stippled edge on a large light headline
avoid: small text: the rim is invisible
mid-grey backgrounds: the dots blend in
when a visible dotted effect is wanted: use the 20% version
